newsitem.title: USA: SI Diamond says revises Preferred E terms.
newsitem.headline: SI Diamond says revises Preferred E terms.

text.p: SI Diamond Technology Inc said on Wednesday it had renegotiated an agreement with holders of its Series E Preferred stock.
The holders agreed to stagger the remainder of their conversions throughout the first quarter of 1997, the company said in a statement.

In exchange, SI Diamond said it would convert a portion of the Series E preferred into 300,000 shares of common stock, raise $1 million or more by October 31 and reduce the issue's fixed strike price from $6.625 to $3.00. The company declined to comment on how it would raise the money.
